# National Cheng Kung University Research Output Portal

> > A comprehensive research publication and researcher profile platform for National Cheng Kung University, enabling discovery of academic outputs and institutional collaboration.

Research NCKU is the official research output portal for National Cheng Kung University in Taiwan, providing centralized access to university publications, researcher profiles, and collaborative research initiatives. The platform prioritizes accessibility and security through WCAG compliance and Cloudflare protection.
